ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level ratio; approximately 85% high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels to 15% low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous low-intensity (black) pigmentation borders the entire trailing edge and lateral tips. A primary vertical dark cluster is located at the basal center (peduncle junction). Discrete dark spots are visible: one focal spot on the mid-right lobe and several smaller specks on the lower-left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, symmetrical V-shaped depression; calculated interior angle approximately 65 degrees with a vertical depth relative to the lobe peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude irregular serrations present along the entire length of the trailing edge, characterized by jagged pixel-level peaks and shallow valleys.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral convex curves extending from the median notch to the distal tips, following a wide-angle aerodynamic sweep.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Presence of dark, unaligned vertical linear streaks near the central peduncle area and a singular diagonal line on the upper-right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Small notches or irregularities in the trailing edge topography, particularly on the left lobe, indicating minor physical trauma or environmental wear.
